name: Search bar
description: A rounded search field with a magnifier and a clear button, and optionally a Cancel button after it, as at the top of a phone list. A <form role="search"> around an <input type="search">, so phones show a Search key. The clear button only shows while there's text.

classes.ayy-search-bar: Root: a <form role="search"> holding the field and an optional Cancel.
classes.ayy-search-bar--lg: Taller field and text, for a search screen.
classes.ayy-search-bar__field: The pill: a magnifier icon, the input and the clear button. The focus ring goes around it.
classes.ayy-search-bar__input: <input type="search" enterkeyhint="search" aria-label placeholder>. Needs a placeholder: the clear button hides while it shows.
classes.ayy-search-bar__clear: A button after the input with an × and aria-label="Clear search". Hidden while the field is empty; @danitesler/ayywi/elements empties the field on click and fires input.
classes.ayy-search-bar__cancel: A text button after the field that ends the search ("Cancel").

default.looks: A pill-shaped wash-hover field with a muted magnifier and placeholder; the clear button and Cancel only show when there's something to clear or cancel.

hover.looks: The clear button gets a wash; Cancel's text softens.

pressed.none: No pressed look; the clear button empties the field and Cancel ends the search at once.

focus.looks: A 2px ring around the pill; the clear and Cancel buttons get their own ring.

disabled.none: Don't disable search: an empty list still takes a query. Hide the bar if search doesn't apply to the screen.

selected.none: Nothing to select. Results are a list under it.

error.none: Any text is a valid query. When nothing matches, show an Empty state under it.

loading.none: No loading look in the field. Show a Skeleton or Spinner where the results appear.

typing.looks: The clear button shows at the inline end (the input needs a placeholder for this).

scale.md: The md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
scale.lg: The lg control height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), larger text: the top of a phone list.

sizes.density: The field height follows data-density (the heights above).
sizes.width: The field fills its row; Cancel takes its own width after it.

js: searchBarClass({ size?, className? }) → string; clearSearchBar(button) empties the field a clear button belongs to, fires input and focuses it (@danitesler/ayywi/elements does it for every clear button); searchBarIcon, searchBarClearIcon (SVG markup).

props.onValueChange: (value: string) => void — every keystroke, and "" when cleared
props.onSearch: (value: string) => void — Enter / the Search key
props.onCancel: () => void — shows a Cancel button that runs it
props.label: string — the input's name. Default "Search"

a11y: role="search" makes the form a search landmark. Name the input (aria-label, or a <label>) by what it searches ("Search tasks").
The clear button is a real button named "Clear search"; clearing puts focus back in the field.
Esc in a type="search" input clears it in most browsers; Cancel is for leaving the search, not clearing it.
Results that update as you type should say how many there are in a polite live region.
do: Use it at the top of a phone list or a search screen; filter as people type (onValueChange) or on Enter (onSearch).
Say what it searches in the placeholder and the label ("Search notes").
Put it in a Top bar's second row on a list's first screen.
dont: Don't use it as a form field for a value — use an Input or a Combobox.
Don't use it for a whole-app ⌘K search on desktop — that's the Command palette.
Don't remove the placeholder: the clear button relies on it.
